newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SHK Prop offers more E.Point City flats.
newsitem.headline: SHK Prop offers more E.Point City flats.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd said on Wednesday it would offer another 152 units in its sale of East Point City flats in Tseung Kwan O in the New Territories.
A company spokeswoman said the third batch of units would be offered at about HK$5,061 per square foot, a three percent increase from the second batch of 152 units offered at HK$4,914 a square foot.
The company initially offered 304 units at HK$4,771 a square foot.
The spokeswoman said 16,100 potential buyers had signed up to buy the flats by the second day of registration on Tuesday.
The registration closes on Wednesday and the units, ranging from 588 to 796 square feet, go on sale on Saturday.
Shares of Sun Hung Kai Properties were up HK$1.00 at HK$95.25 at midday on Wednesday.
